items: The AI worth keeping in a quick-service restaurant proves it saves money, drives sales or makes operations simpler; anything else is a distraction.
Voice AI at the drive-thru is already running across many locations to reduce order errors, handle peak volume and add upsells.
AI hiring tools that screen resumes and schedule interviews shorten the time from open position to first shift, easing pressure on your existing team.
Centralized AI feedback systems, such as Momos, detect patterns across locations, respond to reviews quickly and recover unhappy guests before they stop coming back.
Favor AI that integrates with your POS, scheduling and online ordering systems and removes complexity instead of adding another dashboard to check.
